mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over the prior month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering a sell-off in equities and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE rises above 4.5%, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior month indicate a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in >60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by >0.5% over the prior month, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 315), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening, which depresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 315 and FEDFUNDS rises by >0.1pp, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 over the prior month signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in retail sales (RSAFS) above 720,000 million dollars over the prior month indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not positive in >60% of instances where RSAFS > 720000, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior month indicate a severe labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not negative in >60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines by >0.5%, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over the prior month signals persistent inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not negative in >60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by >0.1% over the prior month, or the Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
